item.text: The behavior is unchanged after the split. I’m pulling exact line references now so I can summarize the maintainability improvements without turning this into a file-by-file diff dump.

Refactored the single-file layout into separate units so the data structure is reusable and the demo is isolated. `BTree` now lives in [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:4) and the sample runner lives in [Main.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/Main.java:1), which is a cleaner boundary than keeping implementation and demo logic mixed together.

Inside `BTree`, I tightened the internal organization by extracting `splitRootIfNeeded`, exposing a reusable `toList()` view, and consolidating node search/insert indexing around a single `findKeyIndex` flow instead of separate parallel helpers ([BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:13), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:27), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:43), [BTree.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/046_b_tree/BTree.java:131)).
